newsitem.title: USA: Noble Drilling buys jackup rig for $26 mln.
newsitem.headline: Noble Drilling buys jackup rig for $26 mln.

text.p: Noble Drilling Corp said Monday it acquired the jackup drilling rig Miss Kitty from Fairweather Offshore LP for $26.25 million.

The Miss Kitty, built in 1983, is a cantilevered jackup capable of working in up to 300 feet of water. The rig is contracted to ONGC, the Indian state oil company, through September 1997, Noble Drilling said.
The company also said it sold its two posted barge rigs, Lewis Dugger and Chuck Syring, to Mallard Bay Drilling Inc, a subsidiary of Energy Ventures Inc.
Nobil said it received $32 million for the two rigs, consisting of $24.5 million in cash and $7.5 million in drill pipe credit.
The transaction removes the company from the inland drilling barge market in keeping with its refocus on deepwater drilling.
